description: Raw intraday option trade-flow for one underlying. Views: 'recent' (recent option trades, newest first), 'summary' (option trade-flow totals by underlying), 'blocks' (large option trades by underlying), 'history' (minute option-flow buckets, newest first), 'cumulative' (cumulative net option net premium by underlying).

apiKey.description: FlashAlpha API key. Omit when calling via /mcp-oauth (OAuth flow); required on /mcp.

limit.description: Max trades returned (recent/blocks: 1–500, default 50). Only applies to 'recent'.

minutes.description: Window size in minutes for 'history' or 'cumulative' (1–10080, default 60/240).

name: get_option_flow
title: Option Trade Flow
